Over this chrome base runs a complex, aggressive geometric pattern consisting of matte black, rubberized panels and circuitlike lines. The material reveals microscopic details: the slight stretch of the spandex around the joints, the rigid texture of the black plates, and the dazzling, reflective highlights bouncing off the silver chrome. The hair creates a sharp, brilliant visual contrast with his skin and the dark atmosphise. The intense blue backlight illuminates individual strands of the platinumwhite hair, transforming the edges into a halo glowing in cyan and white. The hair appears slightly dynamic, as if caught by a soft, artificial breeze or the sheer energy of its own movement.
